intervention: block output plus (alpha - 1) times the original SAE coefficient times its decoder direction; alpha +1 is the no-op
seed_replay: The original biased-dataset seed and prompt are replayed for each alpha; original dataset PNG is retained for the original tile and pixel MAE reference.
heatmaps: Signed scaled SAE feature coefficients: exact zero transparent; negative values transition green near zero through blue to purple at high magnitude; positive values transition yellow near zero through orange to red at high magnitude. Overlay opacity scales with magnitude and remains translucent. Post-re-encoded SAE activations remain nonnegative.
overlay_visibility: Each heatmap tile uses its own 99.5th percentile color scale for visibility. Original tiles show pre-intervention activations. Alpha zero tiles show the pre-intervention map over the edited image to mark the suppressed feature location; the actual post-re-encoded activation at alpha zero is zero.
summary_metrics: mean_metrics_by_group_alpha.csv; each row averages the 20 images in one group at one alpha
